objects.description: Concrete subclass of protobuf_mutator::Mutator that overrides numeric and string mutation methods to use libFuzzer-backed strategies. Constructors are inherited via using-declaration; no additional fields are declared here. Methods are declared but defined elsewhere. Intended for mutating primitive and string fields in protobufs with libFuzzer heuristics. Construction and destruction follow the base class; no special ownership semantics are present in this header.

A mutation utility class for protobuf messages. It provides basic randomized mutations and crossover for protobuf::Message instances, optional post-processing callbacks, and virtual hooks to customize primitive-type mutations. It owns an internal RandomEngine and a registry of post-processors keyed by protobuf descriptors.
